steps.what: Define mechanical model geometry, joints, loads and assumptions for the mechatronic design concept
Create routine mechanical model elements from the specified geometry and parameters
Check mechanical model behavior against independent expectations and accept the model version

tasks.design: Configure native parametric model templates in mechanical simulation software {OTHER} using an engineer-authored specification. The engineer retains topology and physical assumptions, then checks the generated model against independent expectations before accepting it.
tasks.previous_blocker: Routine geometry and parameter entry repeated decisions already made in the model specification.
tasks.enabler_now: Native parameterized elements can instantiate a fully specified model skeleton deterministically.
tasks.still_hard: A runnable model can still misrepresent constraints, loads or real mechanical behavior.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer chooses useful simplifications and recognizes physically implausible behavior.
tasks.altitude: Routine element creation shrinks while modeling judgement and acceptance remain unchanged.

reach.task: Validate mechanical assumptions and model constraints
reach.learn: Independent physical checks and model limitations

evidence.claim: Native parametric elements can instantiate specified mechanical model components; this task-specific configuration and saving are unmeasured.

assumptions: Boundary is creation of mechanical computational models for simulation, excluding physical prototype fabrication. If the task is predominantly physical model making, the proposed saving does not apply.

The mechatronics engineer produces in s1 geometry dimensions and units, component topology, mass properties, joint definitions, boundary conditions, load cases, parameter bounds and independently derived expected responses. Capture and model decisions retain their full time; unsupported topology or missing values require manual construction.
OTHER denotes mechanical modeling and simulation software. Test native parametric libraries and templates before custom code; existing automatic geometry generation earns no new saving.
s2 removes only repeated element instantiation. Independent physical checks, constraint review and acceptance retain all s3 time; execution alone does not prove validity.
unknowns: Share of routine element creation versus physical prototype work
Existing model libraries and independent validation methods
research_questions: Does template instantiation save time after specification and independent physical checks?

already_counted.description: Independent model checking and version acceptance

incremental.description: Maintain checked mechanical templates and parameter rules
Mechanical software library and access support

approvals.approved_version: Exact model topology, geometry, parameters, assumptions and independent validation results accepted in s3; edits void approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R80 gross20 minus7 upkeep gives net13. Range0-3 assumes substantial native generation already exists or physical modeling dominates; model judgement and verification retain time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Observe existing development or manufacturing procedures and capture comparable operational evidence
Calculate specified procedure measures and compare observed results by operation
Analyze causes and feasibility, then suggest improvements supported by the observed evidence

tasks.design: Configure repeatable comparison tables in {SPREADSHEET} from checked operational evidence. The engineer retains observation, causal interpretation and the recommendation; a measured difference is not automatically a correct improvement.
tasks.previous_blocker: Comparable procedure measures needed repeated collation and calculation.
tasks.enabler_now: Native tables and formulas can repeat specified comparisons without selecting their engineering interpretation.
tasks.still_hard: Differences may arise from product mix, measurement error or constraints rather than poor procedure.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer connects operational evidence to feasible changes and tests competing explanations.
tasks.altitude: Less repeated calculation leaves improvement judgement and implementation rights unchanged.

reach.task: Investigate operational causes of lost efficiency
reach.learn: Comparable observations and controlled improvement trials

evidence.claim: Native comparison calculations can support procedure analysis without deciding causes or improvements; savings are unmeasured.

assumptions: Boundary includes procedure observation, repeated quantitative comparison and suggestions, excluding implementation and performance monitoring of individual employees.

The mechatronics engineer produces in s1 operation identifiers, observation periods, product or work categories, measured times and units, counts, defined outcomes, source references and comparison formulas. Observation, comparability checks and capture remain counted; missing or inconsistent evidence requires manual investigation.
Test native tables and reports before custom code. No free procedure-quality, root-cause or beneficial-change flag is assumed.
Only repeated comparison preparation in s2 shrinks; causal interpretation and feasibility retain all s3 time. Existing automatic operational reports earn no saving.
unknowns: Current procedure evidence and repeat calculation burden
National consultation needs for changed operational data use
research_questions: Does repeatable calculation save time after comparability checks and causal interpretation?

already_counted.description: Cause assessment, feasibility review and recommendation checking

incremental.description: Maintain comparison definitions and data mappings

approvals.approved_version: Exact evidence snapshot, comparisons, causal qualifications and improvement suggestions checked before internal release in s3; changes void approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R80 gross20 minus8 upkeep gives net12. Range0-3 assumes limited comparable observations and existing reporting; observation and causal judgement retain time.

steps.what: Develop electronic, mechanical or computerized processes for tasks in dangerous operating environments

tasks.design: Keep development of dangerous-environment processes with the engineer. Existing design references in {DOCS} support investigation without certifying a workable process or replacing physical validation.
tasks.previous_blocker: Novel operating environments require design investigation under uncertain conditions.
tasks.enabler_now: Engineering tools support specific analyses but do not establish automated process development.
tasks.still_hard: Failure behavior and environmental uncertainty need competent investigation.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer recognizes unsupported assumptions and decides what must be tested.
tasks.altitude: Development responsibility and time remain unchanged.

reach.task: Investigate mechanical limits in unusual environments
reach.learn: Environmental failure mechanisms and validation boundaries

evidence.claim: Novel process development for unusual environments remains engineering investigation; no general automation saving is established here.

assumptions: Boundary is developing the process concept through engineering investigation, excluding mission operation and formal deployment authorization.
The engineer assesses constraints directly; no structured safe-environment or viable-process flag is assumed.
Test native engineering tool functions before custom code, without treating existing computation as human baseline.
Zero upkeep because no new tool or workflow is introduced. Specific model creation counted elsewhere must be allocated once in roll-ups.
unknowns: Actual environment and required development evidence
research_questions: Is there a routine calculation component separable from novel development judgement?

incremental.description: No introduced process development automation upkeep

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100 gross0 upkeep0 net0. Familiar mechanisms and new environmental constraints both retain engineering investigation.

steps.what: Monitor system behavior and capture readings against identified calibration references
Calculate specified deviations and trends from the checked system readings
Interpret deviations, check intended adjustments and calibrate system components within approved procedures

tasks.design: Configure native comparison reports in {OTHER} from engineer-checked readings and reference values. The engineer retains physical monitoring, interpretation, adjustment checks and calibration; the report never changes plant controls.
tasks.previous_blocker: Deviation and trend comparisons required repeated calculation and collation.
tasks.enabler_now: Native calibration reports can calculate explicit comparisons deterministically.
tasks.still_hard: Drift, measurement validity and the effect of adjustment require engineering judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer distinguishes sensor error from genuine system behavior.
tasks.altitude: Repeated comparison work shrinks while calibration responsibility remains unchanged.

reach.task: Assess measurement and control interface behavior

evidence.claim: Native comparison reports can calculate deviations from checked readings; this calibration workflow and saving are unmeasured.

assumptions: Boundary includes engineer monitoring, comparison preparation and calibration, excluding production operation and independent equipment release.

The mechatronics engineer produces in s1 asset and channel identifiers, reading, unit, timestamp, operating condition, reference identifier and value, uncertainty or tolerance source and comparison method. Physical observation and capture remain counted; unsupported readings or references require manual resolution.
OTHER denotes calibration and control engineering software. Test native reports before custom code; no verified telemetry, calibration-due flag or automatically safe adjustment is assumed.
Existing automatic trend displays earn no saving. s3 includes outcome checks and retains its whole time; no control write is delegated to the report.
unknowns: Existing calibration reports and repeat calculation burden
research_questions: Do native comparisons save time after reading capture, reference checks and physical calibration?

approvals.approved_version: Exact asset, observed condition, reference version and intended adjustment checked before calibration in s3; changes require renewed checking
